question: According to Bohr's third postulate (Frequency Condition), what happens when an electron makes a transition from a higher energy state ($E_i$) to a lower energy state ($E_f$)?

options.A: It absorbs a photon of energy $h\nu = E_f - E_i$.
options.B: It emits a photon of energy $h\nu = E_i - E_f$.
options.C: It emits an electron of energy $E_i - E_f$.
